note: Downloads stay outside the repository; paths are relative to the root. eo-props reads every file and checks its sha256 before drawing anything; one missing or different file and the sign atlases keep their drawn faces. `files` is written by the fetch tool; the other sections are hand-written: `layouts` are transcribed from the Caltrans sheets' dimension tables (inches, origin top left of the sign, y down; letter heights are cap heights, series per the sheet).

red.from: R1-1, R5-1, R8-3 fills (FHWA SHS 2024 SVG)

black.from: every FHWA SHS 2024 SVG legend fill

white.from: every FHWA SHS 2024 SVG background fill

yellow.from: W8-1, W11-2, W17-1 fills (FHWA SHS 2024 SVG)

green.from: D3-1a, D11-1, R7-8 fills (FHWA SHS 2024 SVG)

seriesCalibration.from: R32C(CA) sheet: H = 3B, D = 5 (legend width of HOUR)

seriesFallbackNote: No sheet used here dimensions a Series D, E or F line's width; those lines (single numerals, and R32's 3/8 in EXCEPT SUNDAY) take the Series C factor and are shrunk to the legend width where one is given.

streetName.legendTextNote: Only the first glyph of the D3-1a sample legend (a capital E, x 1082-1278) is matched against Overpass: the rest of the sample is not read here.
streetName.radiiFrom: the D3-1a VARx8 SVG's own <rect rx> values (white sign 72.125, green field 45, viewBox units)

towAway.drawn: TOW (TANSAT / TANP ANY TIME): the California sign is R107(CA) Tow-Away NO STOPPING 4 TO 6 PM, whose tow-away symbol is published only as a grid sheet (R107 GRID(CA)); not vectorised in this pass

replace.note: the layout's sample numerals (x 208-1520, y 1140-1885) replaced by SF's prima facie 25 at their height and width

regulatory.drawn: OTHER REGULATORY / BIKE REG / BIKE: a catch-all inventory category that names no single sign

guide.drawn: OTHER GUIDE: a catch-all inventory category that names no single sign; the JS green plate is kept with its legend reduced to BUS STOP (the JS names a transit operator, and no face carries a brand)

parkingAngle.drawn: PARKING:PARK AT 90 / PARALLEL: no CA or federal code for PARK AT 90 DEGREE ANGLE (R24(CA) is PARK PARALLEL only)

pay-by-plate.drawn: SFMTA pay-by-plate meter sign: no CA or federal code

passenger-loading.drawn: R25C(CA) PASSENGER LOADING ONLY is the California sign; its layout is not transcribed in this pass

R26(CA).legend: NO PARKING ANY TIME; border and legend red, NO white on a red box, background white

elements.from: F 3 1/2B, G 1 1/8; centred in the box inside the border

R30B(CA).legend: No Parking (symbol), time, day, STREET SWEEPING; border, circle, diagonal and legend red, letter black, background white. Times and day are the sheet's variable slots: filled with the JS face's legend (TUES 8AM-10AM; the JS line 1ST & 3RD OF MONTH has no slot on R30B), not the sheet's example (10AM TO 12PM WEDNESDAY)

elements.from: S 5.875, T 4.875; centre at E + F = 3.25 + 4 below the top, on the centre line
G 8E: the P of the FHWA R8-3 symbol at 8 in, offset from the circle centre as on R8-3 (P ink x 594-1294, circle centre 864, scaled 8/12)
H 2.5, L 3C, K 2.25C, J 1C; V 15.1 is the example line's width, used as the limit

R32(CA).legend: 1 HOUR PARKING 7 A.M. TO 6 P.M. EXCEPT SUNDAY (the sheet's example says 2 HOUR; the numeral is its variable slot, filled with the JS face's 1 HOUR); border and legend green, numeral white on a green box, background white

elements.from: F 3 1/2D, G 1 1/8; centred in the box inside the border
K 2 1/8, L 2 1/2B; centred between the box and the border

R32C(CA).legend: 2 HOUR PARKING 8AM TO 6PM VEHICLES WITH AREA PERMITS EXEMPT (the sheet's DISTRICT 7 line is its variable slot, filled with the JS face's VEHICLES WITH AREA; the JS line MON THRU FRI has no slot); border and legend green, background white

elements.from: E 3.5D, F .75 above the box bottom; centred in the box inside the border
G 1.5, H 3B, D 5; centred between the box and the border

R39-1(CA).legend: NO DOUBLE PARKING ANYTIME COMMERCIAL VEHICLES INCLUDED; border and legend red, NO white on a red box, background white

elements.from: E 3.5B, F .75 above the box bottom; centred in the box inside the border
F .75, H 1.5B; G .5 right of the box, D 5 wide

R99(CA).legend: (International Symbol of Accessibility) PARKING ONLY; border and legend white, background blue

elements.from: 8 in symbol 1 in below the top; the symbol of the FHWA R7-8 layout (the sheet's note: see the SHS appendix symbol), centred

R30B(CA) picket.legend: No Parking (symbol), time, day, STREET SWEEPING; border, circle, diagonal and legend red, letter black, background white. Times and day are the sheet's variable slots: filled with the JS picket face's legend (12:01 A.M. TO 6 A.M., MON WED FRI), not the sheet's example (10AM TO 12PM WEDNESDAY)

elements.from: S 5.875, T 4.875; centre at E + F = 3.25 + 4 below the top, on the centre line
G 8E: the P of the FHWA R8-3 symbol at 8 in, offset from the circle centre as on R8-3 (P ink x 594-1294, circle centre 864, scaled 8/12)
H 2.5, L 3C, K 2.25C, J 1C; V 15.1 is the example line's width, used as the limit
